### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the change that displays converter deletion errors within the removal dialog. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #3914 by displaying converter deletion errors inside the active Remove dialog, making failures accessible without mixing them with page-level list errors. **Changes:** - Adds dialog-local removal error state and an accessible alert. - Clears removal errors when opening, dismissing, or retrying the dialog. - Adds regression tests for failed deletion, successful retry, and cancellation/reopening. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | frontend/​src/​components/​Registry/​ConverterRegistry.tsx | Displays and resets removal errors within the confirmation dialog. | | frontend/​src/​components/​Registry/​ConverterRegistry.test.tsx | Tests error visibility, enabled recovery controls, retry, and error clearing. |
Review effort: Balanced
